word.definition: A shofar is the horn of an animal (usually a ram) blown as a trumpet by the ancient Hebrews in battle and during religious observances. It is used in modern Judaism especially during Rosh Hashanah and at the end of Yom Kippur.

sports_fact.text: Klay Thompson once scored 37 points in a single quarter — a perfect 13-for-13 from the field. The other team scored 24 that quarter.

market.headline: Larry Ellison Scraps Plan to Sell Up to $7.5 Billion Worth of Oracle Stock
market.summary: The billionaire said that no stock was sold, and that he canceled a plan to unload 50 million shares.
